venue_board.what: gdex.pro HyperLiquid PnL leaderboard, `week` window, every row as displayed (self_reported; a venue claim about its own users, not a chain event). Only presence of the operator's own address is checked.
venue_board.payload_origin: live GET https://trade-api.gemach.io/v1/hl/top_traders_by_pnl with the gdex SDK default UA
venue_board.user_agent_rule: the gdex SDK default User-Agent (GdexApiClient DEFAULT_USER_AGENT); a bare client is answered HTTP 403 'Access denied: Non-browser clients not allowed' (measured 2026-10-25)

record.what: The operator's own committed run files (Days 1-3), read by the runner through RightsPipeline.load — not by this tool.
